actual_powerShell_command:
$task='experiments/dl_attitude_replacement_20261026/gru_stream_ncmd_v1'
$lockPath=Join-Path $task 'GRU_STREAM_NCMD_SOURCE_LOCK_v1.json'
$releasePath=Join-Path $task 'GRU_STREAM_NCMD_TRAINING_RELEASE0_v1.json'
$approvalPath=Join-Path $task 'ROOT_TRAINING_APPROVAL_v1.json'
$lockSha=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $lockPath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$release=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $releasePath | ConvertFrom-Json
$approval=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $approvalPath | ConvertFrom-Json
$runPath=Join-Path $task 'runs/GRU32_STREAM72_NCMD_S2026102001'
if ($lockSha -ne '6861d75c444e484b448885105cca57aa9b3728db18aea19eb169191f329ab57a') { throw "approved source lock mismatch: $lockSha" }
if ($approval.status -ne 'APPROVED_ONE_FIXED_NCMD_TARGET_TRAINING_JOB' -or $approval.approved_lock_sha256 -ne $lockSha -or $approval.authorized_jobs -ne 1 -or $approval.optimizer_steps -ne 60000) { throw 'root approval mismatch' }
if ($release.status -ne 'APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING' -or $release.approved -ne $true -or $release.authorized_jobs -ne 1 -or $release.source_lock_sha256 -ne $lockSha) { throw 'training release mismatch' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runPath) { throw "single-run output already exists: $runPath" }
$activeTraining=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(python|pythonw)(\.exe)?$' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'gru_stream_(ncmd|cosine|c5_teacher)|train_gru_stream|GRU32_STREAM72.*--train' }
if ($activeTraining) { $activeTraining | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-List; throw 'another matching training process is active' }
Set-Location -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\35326\Desktop\postgraduation\0\Mcode\drone_tcn\DL1018'
$env:MKL_THREADING_LAYER = 'SEQUENTIAL'
$env:OMP_NUM_THREADS = '1'
$env:MKL_NUM_THREADS = '1'
$env:CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG = ':4096:8'
$attemptLog = 'experiments/dl_attitude_replacement_20261026/gru_stream_ncmd_v1/logs/attempt01'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $attemptLog | Out-Null
$script = 'experiments/dl_attitude_replacement_20261026/gru_stream_ncmd_v1/train_gru_stream_ncmd_v1.py'
$pythonCode = "import os,runpy,sys,numpy,torch,scipy.io; os.environ.pop('KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK',None); sys.argv=[r'$script','--train','--device','cuda:0']; runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')"
python -u -c $pythonCode 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $attemptLog 'GRU32_STREAM72_NCMD_S2026102001.stdout.log')
$trainingExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
exit $trainingExitCode

environment.KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK: unset in Python child after dependency preload
